team.name: Barupati Srikanth
team.bio: Previously built the last-mile network at a national logistics firm. Believes rider economics, not vehicle specs, decide whether EVs win.

team.name: Meera Krishnan
team.bio: Ex-payments infrastructure engineer. Architected SGD OS and the telematics stack that keeps the fleet observable in real time.

team.name: Sanjay Gupta
team.bio: Twenty years running distribution networks across tier-2 and tier-3 India. Owns the hub and swap-station rollout.

team.name: Nisha Bhatt
team.bio: Former infrastructure-fund investor. Designed the asset-leasing structure that lets franchise partners enter with modest capital.

team.name: Rahul Iyer
team.bio: Climate scientist turned operator. Runs the measurement methodology behind every carbon number we publish.

team.name: Fatima Qureshi
team.bio: Started as a hub manager in Mumbai. Now responsible for onboarding, training and the rider grievance process nationwide.

reviews.name: Arun P.
reviews.text: Switched three months back. My fuel bill was ₹9,000 a month. Now it is nothing.

reviews.name: Farhan S.
reviews.text: Battery swap takes under two minutes. I have never had to wait at a hub.

reviews.name: Deepak R.
reviews.text: My scooter failed on a Tuesday. They handed me another one the same morning.

reviews.name: Kavita M.
reviews.text: No licence needed on the low-speed model. That is the only reason I could start.

reviews.name: Sameer T.
reviews.text: Earnings land in my account every night. No arguments, no follow-up calls.

reviews.name: Rohit K.
reviews.text: Insurance was already included. I did not expect that at this rental price.

reviews.name: Nasir A.
reviews.text: I run eight vehicles now. The dashboard tells me which one is idle before I ask.

reviews.name: Lakshmi V.
reviews.text: Servicing costs me nothing. That alone is ₹1,500 back in my pocket each month.

reviews.name: Gurpreet S.
reviews.text: Two years on the platform and not one day lost to a breakdown.

reviews.name: Manoj B.
reviews.text: Rent to own means it becomes mine. My father did not believe me until he saw the papers.

reviews.name: Srinivas D.
reviews.text: Support answered me in Telugu. Small thing, but it made the whole difference.

reviews.name: Imtiaz H.
reviews.text: A full day of riding costs me about ₹20 to charge. Petrol was ₹300.
